review.why: Runs a job-search pipeline: records, stages, follow-up clock, weekly review and drafted messages the user sends.
review.summary: Treats each opportunity as a record with a stage, real dates, the exact resume sent and a next action. Covers intake with scam checks, stage mapping, a follow-up clock, a weekly review with funnel stats, message drafts (referral, thank-you, follow-up, withdrawal) and offer handling. Works with a Markdown or CSV tracker, or with Reactive Resume tools.
strengths: Never applies or sends: it drafts and logs, the user acts
Scam and ghost-posting checks at intake
Honest funnel numbers: counts below 30 applications, furthest stage reached
cautions: Very long (50,000 characters) with six reference files
Timing rules and benchmarks rely on US vendor data
The tool section needs Reactive Resume; otherwise a plain CSV tracker
